plan: Wave 2 of the Web Export blueprint (plan/web-export-blueprint.md), run from a fresh Claude Code session on Joe's workstation after wave 1 is merged and pushed. Wave 1 delivered the pure-pxr core (report, settings, inventory, USD-folder profile and writer, validate, api), the viewer reading /WebSettings, the package file and installer (dry-run proven), and the brand, README and explainer video. A verified Houdini 22.0.400 API brief for the HDA is in .token-saver/m5-api-brief.md.

environment.cloud: An AI coding agent (Claude Code) working in a git worktree with Python 3.14 and usd-core 26.5, Node 24, headless Chromium and ffmpeg. It must not run Houdini or hython, write the Houdini user prefs, or act in Joe's GitHub account.
environment.desk: Joe's Windows workstation session: Houdini 22.0.400, 22.0.429, 22.0.466 and 22.0.492 with hython, the Houdini 22.0 user prefs folder (two exist: OneDrive Documents/houdini22.0 holds the packages; C:/Users/User/houdini22.0 also exists, so every hython run pins HOUDINI_USER_PREF_DIR to the OneDrive one), and his GitHub account through the gh CLI. Joe has approved the package install, --verify, the hython 22.0.400 import check, and building and testing the HDA on 22.0.400, 22.0.492 and 22.0.466.
environment.joe: Joe Ibrahim: a senior lighting TD and solo developer who owns every product, licensing, money and taste decision. Already decided: Web Export lives in this repo, min_num_inputs is 1, the M5 check uses 22.0.492 instead of 22.0.459, the video stays silent.

tasks.title: Install the package into Houdini prefs
tasks.detail: Run python scripts/install_package.py from the main checkout with HOUDINI_USER_PREF_DIR pinned to the OneDrive Documents/houdini__HVER__ folder, writing the resolved package file into its packages folder, then run --verify and confirm exit code 0.

tasks.title: Check hython imports webexport
tasks.detail: Run hython 22.0.400 -B -c with the same pinned HOUDINI_USER_PREF_DIR, import webexport, print webexport.__file__ and hou.houdiniPath(), and confirm the module comes from the repo.

tasks.title: Export in-memory LOP stages
tasks.detail: Make webexport.api.export accept a stage whose root layer is anonymous, as a Houdini LOP stage's is: merge the layer stack with UsdUtils.FlattenLayerStack, stage it to a file, then hand that file to the existing USD-folder writer, deciding FIX FIRST before anything is written. Prove it with usd-core unit tests that run in CI.

tasks.title: Probe the 43 open questions in hython
tasks.detail: Before building the HDA, run short hython 22.0.400 probes in a throwaway session that settle the API brief's open questions: whether /stage exists, the Sublayer LOP's filepath1 parm, whether a new LOP subnet already has output0, whether pressButton runs Python callbacks headless, and how an inner Error LOP's message reaches the asset.

tasks.title: Build the Web Export HDA
tasks.detail: Write scripts/build_hda.py and python/webexport/hou_node.py, then build houdini/otls/web_export.hda with hython 22.0.400: a LOP subnet HDA mythandlogic::web_export::1.0 with min_num_inputs 1, the seven web settings, an Output Folder, format toggles, and Check, Export and Preview buttons whose callbacks call hou_node and nothing else; the verdict badge comes from an inner Error LOP listed in MessageNodes.

tasks.title: Test the HDA on three Houdini builds
tasks.detail: Run tests/hou/test_hda.py with hython 22.0.400, 22.0.492 and 22.0.466: install the HDA, load fixtures/stage/shot.usda with a Sublayer LOP, press Check (verdict GO) and Export (the folder exists and the census says GO).

tasks.title: Check the Preview button can start the server
tasks.detail: Verify whether a LOP HDA button callback can start node server/serve.mjs on Windows while Houdini stays responsive, without opening a browser during the test, then record the result in blueprint section 6, item 1.

tasks.title: Merge wave 2, test and push
tasks.detail: Merge the wave 2 work onto main, run npm test, the Python unit tests, the browser test and the hython HDA test, push to GitHub and watch CI.

tasks.title: Write the Web Export card and release 0.2.0
tasks.detail: Write docs/web-export.md, update the README tools table and repo map, bump the version to 0.2.0 and create the GitHub release with tools/release.py.

tasks.title: Decide when glTF and X3D start
tasks.detail: Choose whether the glTF mission (M7) and the X3D mission (M8) start right after 0.2.0 ships, or later.
